{{Quote|We had a Rebel strike team infiltrate an Imperial base on Geonosis. The team was discovered and captured.|Rahm Kota|<ref name="ES DS" />}}
During the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="ES DS" /> at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Dating" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] attempted to '''infiltrate''' an old [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Geonosis Imperial base|droid foundry]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The Imperial base possessed strong [[Anti-aircraft weaponry|anti-air defenses]]. A [[Geonosis strike team (Rebel)|Rebel strike team]] was sent to the planet, but due to the team's large numbers, it was soon discovered and captured by the Empire. When the Alliance learned about the mission's failure, they organized a [[Mission to Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|rescue operation]] to liberate the captured [[unit]]. This time, however, the Rebellion took heed of its mistake and dispatched a much smaller force, consisting only of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]]. The two of them successfully liberated the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], and the surviving members of the strike team were reorganized into [[Grey Squadron]] under X2's command.<ref name="ES DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This mission was alluded to in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''.<ref name="ES DS" />
